name: Briclinks Africa PLC
source: CRON 2026-11-21: Briclinks Africa Plc unaudited statement of profit or loss and other comprehensive income for the nine months ended 30 September 2026 (NGX doclib filing library, page 4, 9 Months 30 Sep 2026 column), printed in naira. Revenue less Cost of Sales equals the printed gross profit of 171,692,245; gross profit less administrative expenses of 114,884,661 equals operating profit of 56,807,584, and operating profit less finance costs of 2,068,123 equals the printed profit before tax of 54,739,460. No income tax was charged and profit after tax is the same figure. EPS is the printed basic and diluted earnings per share of 5.47 naira. | CRON 20261014: Briclinks Africa Plc statement of profit or loss for the period ended 30 June 2026 (NGX doclib filing library), whole naira as printed. The filing prints two quarterly columns only, Apr-Jun 2026 and Jan-Mar 2026, so the H1 figures are the sum of those two printed columns. Each printed column ties internally, and the sums reproduce both identities: turnover less cost of sales equals the printed gross profit and gross profit less overheads equals the printed profit before taxation. The filing prints no income tax for the period, so no tax cell is written. | NGX filing library, Briclinks Africa Plc audited financial statements for the year ended 31 December 2025 (NGN, as printed). Cost of Sales is the printed charge of 358,623,267 (2024: 286,699,292) stored as a positive deduction. Operating Expenses is the printed Administrative Expenses line. Operating Profit (EBIT) is Gross Profit less Administrative Expenses. Net Finance Costs is Interest Payable and Similar Charges. Profit Before Tax less Income Tax equals the printed Profit on Ordinary Activities After Tax in both years. | CRON 20261116 NGX filing fill: H1 2026 Income Tax filled from the issuer filing. Each value is read from the printed statement named in repairs, not derived.
